readings.title: Aleph
readings.subtitle: The Blessedness of Walking in the Torah
readings.text: [Psalm 119:1] Aleph Blessed are the perfect in the way, Who walk in the Torah of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! [2] Blessed are those who observe <dn>His</dn> witnesses, Who seek <dn>Him</dn> with all the heart! [3] Yes, they shall do no unrighteousness; They shall walk in <dn>His</dn> ways. [4] <dn>You</dn> have commanded us To guard <dn>Your</dn> orders diligently. [5] Oh, that my ways were established To guard <dn>Your</dn> laws! [6] Then I would not be ashamed, When I look into all <dn>Your</dn> commands. [7] I thank <dn>You</dn> with uprightness of heart, When I learn the right-rulings of <dn>Your</dn> righteousness. [8] I guard <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> laws; Oh, do not leave me entirely!

readings.title: Bět
readings.subtitle: Cleansing the Path with the Word
readings.text: [Psalm 119:9] Bět How would a young man cleanse <dn>את</dn> his path? To guard it according to <dn>Your</dn> word. [10] I have sought <dn>You</dn> with all my heart; Let me not stray from <dn>Your</dn> commands! [11] I have treasured up <dn>Your</dn> word in my heart, That I might not sin against <dn>You</dn>. [12] Blessed are <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! Teach me <dn>Your</dn> laws. [13] With my lips I have recounted All the right-rulings of <dn>Your</dn> mouth. [14] I have rejoiced in the way of <dn>Your</dn> witnesses, As over all riches. [15] I meditate on <dn>Your</dn> orders, And regard <dn>Your</dn> ways. [16] I delight myself in <dn>Your</dn> laws; I do not forget <dn>Your</dn> word.

readings.title: Gimel
readings.subtitle: A Sojourner's Plea for Understanding
readings.text: [Psalm 119:17] Gimel Do good to <dn>Your</dn> servant, Let me live and I guard <dn>Your</dn> word. [18] Open my eyes, that I might see Wonders from <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [19] I am a sojourner in the earth; Do not hide <dn>Your</dn> commands from me. [20] My being is crushed with longing For <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings at all times. [21] <dn>You</dn> rebuked the proud, cursed ones, Who are straying from <dn>Your</dn> commands. [22] Remove from me reproach and scorn, For I have observed <dn>Your</dn> witnesses. [23] Though princes sat, speaking against me, <dn>Your</dn> servant meditates on <dn>Your</dn> laws. [24] <dn>Your</dn> witnesses also are my delight, My counsellors.

readings.title: Dalet
readings.subtitle: Revival from the Dust
readings.text: [Psalm 119:25] Dalet My being has been clinging to the dust; Revive me according to <dn>Your</dn> word. [26] I have recounted my ways and <dn>You</dn> answered me; Teach me <dn>Your</dn> laws. [27] Make me understand the way of <dn>Your</dn> orders; That I might meditate on <dn>Your</dn> wonders. [28] My being has wept from grief; Strengthen me according to <dn>Your</dn> word. [29] Remove from me the way of falsehood, And favour me with <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [30] I have chosen the way of truth; <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings I have held level. [31] I have clung to <dn>Your</dn> witnesses; O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, do not put me to shame! [32] I run the way of <dn>Your</dn> commands, For <dn>You</dn> enlarge my heart.

readings.title: Hě
readings.subtitle: A Prayer for an Inclined Heart
readings.text: [Psalm 119:33] Hě Teach me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, the way of <dn>Your</dn> laws, And I observe it to the end. [34] Make me understand, that I might observe <dn>Your</dn> Torah, And guard it with all my heart. [35] Make me walk in the path of <dn>Your</dn> commands, For I have delighted in it. [36] Incline my heart to <dn>Your</dn> witnesses, And not to own gain. [37] Turn away my eyes from looking at falsehood, And revive me in <dn>Your</dn> way. [38] Establish <dn>Your</dn> word to <dn>Your</dn> servant, Which leads to the fear of <dn>You</dn>. [39] Turn away my reproach which I dread, For <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings are good. [40] See, I have longed for <dn>Your</dn> orders; Revive me in <dn>Your</dn> righteousness.

readings.title: Waw
readings.subtitle: Confidence in God's Deliverance
readings.text: [Psalm 119:41] Waw And let <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitments come to me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; <dn>Your</dn> deliverance, according to <dn>Your</dn> word, [42] So that I answer my reprover, For I have trusted in <dn>Your</dn> word. [43] And do not take away from my mouth The word of truth entirely, For I have waited for <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings; [44] That I might guard <dn>Your</dn> Torah continually, Forever and ever; [45] That I might walk in a broad place, For I have sought <dn>Your</dn> orders; [46] That I might speak of <dn>Your</dn> witnesses before sovereigns, And not be ashamed; [47] That I might delight myself in <dn>Your</dn> commands, Which I have loved; [48] That I might lift up my hands to <dn>Your</dn> commands, Which I have loved; While I meditate on <dn>Your</dn> laws.

readings.title: Zayin
readings.subtitle: Comfort in Affliction
readings.text: [Psalm 119:49] Zayin Remember the word to <dn>Your</dn> servant, On which <dn>You</dn> have caused me to wait. [50] This is my comfort in my affliction, For <dn>Your</dn> word has given me life. [51] The proud have utterly scorned me, I did not turn aside from <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [52] I remembered <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings of old, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And I comfort myself. [53] Rage has seized me because of the wrong Who forsake <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [54] <dn>Your</dn> laws have been my songs In the place of my sojournings. [55] I have remembered <dn>Your</dn> Name in the night, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And I guard <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [56] This has become mine, Because I have observed <dn>Your</dn> orders.

readings.title: Ḥet
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH is My Portion
readings.text: [Psalm 119:57] Ḥet <dn>You</dn> are my portion, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; I have promised to guard <dn>Your</dn> words. [58] I have sought <dn>Your</dn> face with all my heart; Show me favour according to <dn>Your</dn> word. [59] I have thought upon my ways, And turned my feet to <dn>Your</dn> witnesses. [60] I have hurried, and did not delay To guard <dn>Your</dn> commands. [61] The cords of the wrong have surrounded me, <dn>Your</dn> Torah I have not forgotten. [62] At midnight I rise to give thanks to <dn>You</dn>, For <dn>Your</dn> righteous right-rulings. [63] I am a companion of all who fear <dn>You</dn>, And of those guarding <dn>Your</dn> orders. [64] O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment has filled the earth; Teach me <dn>Your</dn> laws.

readings.title: Tet
readings.subtitle: The Goodness of Affliction
readings.text: [Psalm 119:65] Tet <dn>You</dn> have done good to <dn>Your</dn> servant, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, According to <dn>Your</dn> word. [66] Teach me good sense and knowledge, For I have trusted in <dn>Your</dn> commands. [67] Before I was afflicted I myself was going astray, But now I have guarded <dn>Your</dn> word. [68] <dn>You</dn> are good, and do good; Teach me <dn>Your</dn> laws. [69] The proud have forged a lie against me, With all my heart I observe <dn>Your</dn> orders. [70] Their heart has become like fat, Without feeling; I have delighted in <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [71] It was good for me that I was afflicted, That I might learn <dn>Your</dn> laws. [72] The Torah of <dn>Your</dn> mouth is better to me Than thousands of gold and silver pieces.

readings.title: Yod
readings.subtitle: Fashioned by God's Hands
readings.text: [Psalm 119:73] Yod <dn>Your</dn> hands have made me and formed me; Make me understand, that I might learn <dn>Your</dn> commands. [74] Those who fear <dn>You</dn> see me and rejoice, For I have waited for <dn>Your</dn> Word. [75] I know, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, That <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings are righteous, And in trustworthiness <dn>You</dn> have afflicted me. [76] Please let <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment be for my comfort, According to <dn>Your</dn> word to <dn>Your</dn> servant. [77] Let <dn>Your</dn> compassions come to me, That I might live, For <dn>Your</dn> Torah is my delight. [78] Let the proud be put to shame, For with lies they perverted me; But I study <dn>Your</dn> orders. [79] Let those who fear <dn>You</dn> turn to me, And those who know <dn>Your</dn> witnesses. [80] Let my heart be perfect in <dn>Your</dn> laws, So that I am not put to shame.

readings.title: Kaph
readings.subtitle: Pining for Deliverance
readings.text: [Psalm 119:81] Kaph For <dn>Your</dn> deliverance my being has pined away, For I have waited for <dn>Your</dn> word. [82] My eyes have pined away for <dn>Your</dn> word, Saying, “When would it comfort me?” [83] For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, <dn>Your</dn> laws I have not forgotten. [84] How many are the days of <dn>Your</dn> servant? When do <dn>You</dn> execute right-ruling On those who persecute me? [85] The proud have dug pits for me, Which is not according to <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [86] All <dn>Your</dn> commands are trustworthy; They have persecuted me with lies; Help me! [87] They almost made an end of me on earth, But I, I did not forsake <dn>Your</dn> orders. [88] Revive me according to <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, That I might guard the witness of <dn>Your</dn> mouth.

readings.title: Lamed
readings.subtitle: The Eternality of God's Word
readings.text: [Psalm 119:89] Lamed Forever, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Your</dn> word stands firm in the heavens. [90] <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness is to all generations; <dn>You</dn> established the earth, and it stands. [91] According to <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings They have stood to this day, For all are <dn>Your</dn> servants. [92] If <dn>Your</dn> Torah had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction. [93] Let me never forget <dn>Your</dn> orders, For by them <dn>You</dn> have given me life. [94] I am <dn>Yours</dn>, save me; For I have sought <dn>Your</dn> orders. [95] The wrong have waited for me to destroy me; I understand <dn>Your</dn> witnesses. [96] I have seen an end of all perfection; <dn>Your</dn> command is exceedingly broad.

readings.title: Mem
readings.subtitle: Love for the Torah
readings.text: [Psalm 119:97] Mem O how I love <dn>Your</dn> Torah! It is my study all day long. [98] <dn>Your</dn> commands make me wiser than my enemies; For it is ever before me. [99] I have more understanding than all my teachers, For <dn>Your</dn> witnesses are my study. [100] I understand more than the aged, For I have observed <dn>Your</dn> orders. [101] I have restrained my feet from every evil way, That I might guard <dn>Your</dn> word. [102] I have not turned aside from <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings, For <dn>You</dn> <dn>Yourself</dn> have taught me. [103] How sweet to my taste has <dn>Your</dn> word been, More than honey to my mouth! [104] From <dn>Your</dn> orders I get understanding; Therefore I have hated every false way.

readings.title: Nun
readings.subtitle: A Lamp to My Feet
readings.text: [Psalm 119:105] Nun <dn>Your</dn> word is a lamp to my feet And a light to my path. [106] I have sworn, and I confirm, To guard <dn>Your</dn> righteous right-rulings. [107] I have been afflicted very much; O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, revive me according to <dn>Your</dn> word. [108] Please accept the voluntary offerings Of my mouth, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And teach me <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings. [109] My life is in my hand continually, And <dn>Your</dn> Torah I have not forgotten. [110] The wrong have laid a snare for me, But I have not strayed from <dn>Your</dn> orders. [111] <dn>Your</dn> witnesses are my inheritance forever, For they are the joy of my heart. [112] I have inclined my heart to do <dn>Your</dn> laws Forever, to the end.

readings.title: Sameḵ
readings.subtitle: Hiding Place and Shield
readings.text: [Psalm 119:113] Sameḵ I have hated doubting thoughts, But I have loved <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [114] <dn>You</dn> are my hiding place and my shield; I have waited for <dn>Your</dn> word. [115] Turn away from me, you evil-doers, For I observe the commands of my <dn>Elohim</dn>! [116] Support me according to <dn>Your</dn> word, That I might live; And put me not to shame Because of my expectation. [117] Sustain me, that I might be saved, And always look to <dn>Your</dn> laws. [118] <dn>You</dn> have made light of all those Who stray from <dn>Your</dn> laws, For falsehood is their deceit. [119] <dn>You</dn> have made to cease All the wrong of the earth, like dross; Therefore I have loved <dn>Your</dn> witnesses. [120] My flesh has trembled for fear of <dn>You</dn>, And I am in awe of <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings.

readings.title: Ayin
readings.subtitle: A Servant's Plea for Justice
readings.text: [Psalm 119:121] Ayin I have done right-ruling and righteousness; Leave me not to my oppressors. [122] Guarantee <dn>Your</dn> servant’s well-being; Let not the proud oppress me. [123] My eyes have pined away for <dn>Your</dn> deliverance, And for the word of <dn>Your</dn> righteousness. [124] Do with <dn>Your</dn> servant according to <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, And teach me <dn>Your</dn> laws. [125] I am <dn>Your</dn> servant – make me understand, That I might know <dn>Your</dn> witnesses. [126] It is time for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to act! For they have broken <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [127] Therefore I have loved <dn>Your</dn> commands More than gold, even fine gold! [128] Therefore all <dn>Your</dn> orders I count as right; I have hated every false way.

readings.title: Pě
readings.subtitle: The Wonder of God's Word
readings.text: [Psalm 119:129] Pě <dn>Your</dn> witnesses are wonders; So my being observes them. [130] The opening up of <dn>Your</dn> words gives light, Giving understanding to the simple. [131] I have opened my mouth and panted, For I have longed for <dn>Your</dn> commands. [132] Turn to me and show me favour, According to <dn>Your</dn> right-ruling, toward those who love <dn>Your</dn> Name. [133] Establish my footsteps by <dn>Your</dn> word, And let no wickedness have rule over me. [134] Redeem me from the oppression of man, That I might guard <dn>Your</dn> orders. [135] Make <dn>Your</dn> face shine upon <dn>Your</dn> servant, And teach me <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> laws. [136] Streams of water have run down from my eyes, Because they did not guard <dn>Your</dn> Torah.

readings.title: Tsadi
readings.subtitle: The Righteousness of God's Judgments
readings.text: [Psalm 119:137] Tsadi Righteous are <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings are straight. [138] <dn>You</dn> have commanded <dn>Your</dn> witnesses In righteousness and truth, exceedingly. [139] My ardour has consumed me, For my adversaries have forgotten <dn>Your</dn> words. [140] <dn>Your</dn> word is tried, exceedingly; And <dn>Your</dn> servant has loved it. [141] I am small and despised; I have not forgotten <dn>Your</dn> orders. [142] <dn>Your</dn> righteousness is righteousness forever, And <dn>Your</dn> Torah is truth. [143] Distress and anguish have found me; <dn>Your</dn> commands are my delight. [144] The righteousness of <dn>Your</dn> witnesses is forever; Make me understand, that I might live.

readings.title: Qoph
readings.subtitle: A Cry from the Whole Heart
readings.text: [Psalm 119:145] Qoph I have called with all my heart; Answer me, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! I observe <dn>Your</dn> laws. [146] I have called upon <dn>You</dn>; Save me, that I might guard <dn>Your</dn> witnesses. [147] I rise before dawn, and cry for help; I have waited for <dn>Your</dn> word. [148] My eyes have gone before the night watches, To study <dn>Your</dn> word. [149] Hear my voice according to <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment; O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, revive me according to <dn>Your</dn> right-ruling. [150] Those who pursue mischief have drawn near; They have been far from <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [151] <dn>You</dn> are near, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And all <dn>Your</dn> commands are truth. [152] Of old I have known <dn>Your</dn> witnesses, That <dn>You</dn> have founded them forever.

readings.title: Rěsh
readings.subtitle: Plea for Deliverance and Revival
readings.text: [Psalm 119:153] Rěsh See my affliction and deliver me, For I have not forgotten <dn>Your</dn> Torah. [154] Plead my cause and redeem me; Revive me according to <dn>Your</dn> word. [155] Deliverance is far from the wrong ones, For they have not sought <dn>Your</dn> laws. [156] <dn>Your</dn> compassions are many, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Revive me according to <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings. [157] My persecutors and adversaries are many; I have not turned aside from <dn>Your</dn> witnesses. [158] I saw traitors and was grieved, Because they did not guard <dn>Your</dn> word. [159] See how I have loved <dn>Your</dn> orders, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, revive me according to <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment. [160] The sum of <dn>Your</dn> word is truth, And all <dn>Your</dn> righteous right-rulings are forever.

readings.title: Shin
readings.subtitle: Rejoicing in the Word
readings.text: [Psalm 119:161] Shin Rulers have persecuted me without a cause, But at <dn>Your</dn> word my heart stood in awe. [162] I rejoice at <dn>Your</dn> word As one who finds great treasure. [163] I have hated falsehood and loathe it, <dn>Your</dn> Torah I have loved. [164] I have praised <dn>You</dn> seven times a day, Because of <dn>Your</dn> righteous right-rulings. [165] Great peace have those loving <dn>Your</dn> Torah, And for them there is no stumbling-block. [166] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, I have waited for <dn>Your</dn> deliverance, And I have done <dn>Your</dn> commands. [167] My being has guarded <dn>Your</dn> witnesses, And I love them exceedingly. [168] I have guarded <dn>Your</dn> orders and <dn>Your</dn> witnesses, For all my ways are before <dn>You</dn>.

readings.title: Tav
readings.subtitle: A Prayer for Understanding and Restoration
readings.text: [Psalm 119:169] Tav My cry comes before <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Make me understand according to <dn>Your</dn> word. [170] Let my prayer come before <dn>You</dn>; Deliver me according to <dn>Your</dn> word. [171] My lips pour forth praise, For <dn>You</dn> teach me <dn>Your</dn> laws. [172] My tongue sings of <dn>Your</dn> word, For all <dn>Your</dn> commands are righteousness. [173] <dn>Your</dn> hand is a help to me, For I have chosen <dn>Your</dn> orders. [174] I have longed for <dn>Your</dn> deliverance, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And <dn>Your</dn> Torah is my delight. [175] My being lives, and it praises <dn>You</dn>; And <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings help me. [176] I have strayed like a lost sheep; Seek <dn>Your</dn> servant, For I have not forgotten <dn>Your</dn> commands.
